findings.message: Hardcoded AWS region fallback without validation against allowed regions
findings.fix_description: Added ALLOWED_REGIONS whitelist validation and proper region selection logic to prevent invalid AWS credentials or unexpected behavior

findings.message: Type 'any' used in error metadata access, bypassing type safety
findings.fix_description: Replaced 'any' with 'Record<string, unknown>' to maintain type safety while preserving dynamic property access

findings.message: Error handling may expose internal error details that should not be logged in production
findings.fix_description: Changed error logging to only log error message and type rather than full error objects which may contain sensitive details

findings.message: User-supplied PR title, author, and repository inserted into Claude prompt without sanitization - potential prompt injection vulnerability
findings.fix_description: Added sanitizeForPrompt() function that removes newlines, backticks, and limits length to prevent prompt injection attacks. Applied to all user inputs before insertion into prompts.

findings.message: Missing input validation for SynthesisRequest - could accept malformed or malicious data
findings.fix_description: Added comprehensive validateSynthesisRequest() function that validates all input fields, enforces size limits, validates URL format, and protects against oversized arrays

findings.message: Error objects logged without sanitization, may expose internal details
findings.fix_description: Changed error logging to only log error.message instead of full error objects, preventing exposure of stack traces and internal details

summary: Found 6 security finding(s) — fixed 6 in 2 file(s).
